newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Gold Fields interim shr surges, div steady.
newsitem.headline: Gold Fields interim shr surges, div steady.

text.p: Full name: Gold Fields of South Africa Ltd

NOTE - The company said that its substantial increase in attributable profit was largely due to improved dividends from the group's gold mining investments, a very good operating performance at Zincor and higher interest earnings.
However, Northam Platinum Ltd incurred a loss of nine million rand to December 1996 compared to a profit of 14 million in the six months to June 1996.

Gold Fields said that if the gold price remained at the current depressed level and no further surpluses or realisations from investments are achieved, it is anticipated that the profit attributable to ordinary shares for the next six months will be relatively unchanged from that of the six months to December 1996.
